actualDefect.SELF_HELP_STOP: Measured against NM.memo.json track nm_dna_expungement, whose three selfHelpStopConditions are: (1) 'Every matter under this section, until the statutory text is read at an official channel and the receiving agency and request format are established.'; (2) any prior felony conviction or pending authorized-felony charge; (3) obtaining certified dispositions. (2) and (3) are carried, and the receiving-agency/format limb of (1) is carried ('Confirm every one with the New Mexico Department of Public Safety before sending anything'). The statutory-text limb of (1) is not: nothing tells the participant that § 29-16-10 has not been read at an official New Mexico channel, and the guide presents the eligibility branches as 'The recorded qualifying branches are...'. The memo's legalDesignDecision.status is legal_research_required with a build_blocker on exactly this point. The approval-request routes the same question to counsel before promotion, but the participant is not told. One of three controlling stops is carried only in part. (Prior vf02 readings scored this PASS on the view that the blanket stop is carried as a confirm-with-DPS condition; this reading measures the missing limb.) LD-NM-02 adds the 30/45-day processing-period rule, which the packet carries.
actualDefect.SERVICE: Silence. Neither participant-instructions.md nor the text of either fixture says anything about service or notice: no service rule, no statement that nobody else is served, and no authority named for the question. The controlling memo records rules.service 'Not determined.' and rules.notice 'Not determined.'; the route contract and census carry no service rule. The DPS-confirmation sentence covers center, unit, destination, format and fee only. Under the brief's standard (a named rule, or an affirmative nobody-is-served statement with the mechanism) and DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001 as extended to SERVICE (a named authority may stand in only where the packet says no held source establishes the rule), this is not met.
